per_object_cap.stated: 10GB per file on StackSocial plans (free plans 100MB, Essential 10GB, Premium 50GB, Ultimate 100GB)

retention.stated: 10 TB Lifetime Storage: pay once and keep your storage permanently, with no renewal fees. The page states no file-expiry or inactivity-deletion clause.

egress.terms: No published egress cap found on any pricing page. Vendor FAQ silent on bandwidth. Absence of a clause is not a guarantee.

interface_detail: The StackSocial plan does not include CLI, WebDAV or Rclone, which Internxt sells separately. Native rclone and WebDAV via the Internxt CLI require an Ultimate annual or lifetime plan; the S3-compatible object storage is a separate subscription.
tooling: Apps for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS plus a web app. CLI, WebDAV and native rclone are not part of the StackSocial plan.
chaining: StackSocial codes are not stackable. Storage stacks by buying a lifetime plan directly from Internxt with the same login.

limits.value: reviewers report 'Files disappear from time to time' and 'stored files are [gone]'

limits_note: StackSocial codes are not stackable and the StackSocial offer is for new users only. Internxt's own lifetime plans are stackable; buying a lifetime plan directly from Internxt with the same login as a StackSocial account stacks the storage. Both statements apply, to different purchase routes.

identity_cost.detail: Account signup asks for a name and an email address with no identity or email verification. The StackSocial checkout fields are unverified: behind a purchase.

reliability_note: Documented file-loss pattern, not a single incident: a GitHub controlled test uploaded 198 files and lost some; Trustpilot reviewers report 'Files disappear from time to time' and 'stored files are [gone]'; a 1-year user reported all images and videos gone with support unresponsive. Desktop sync described as non-functional by lifetime holders.
